name: brandize
description: AI logo generation, brand color palettes, SEO meta tags, JSON-LD schema markup, and blog search.

interface.shortDescription: AI logos, brand kits, and SEO markup
interface.longDescription: Connects the hosted Brandize MCP server. Generates logos and full brand kits — lockups, favicons, social assets, print collateral — plus brand color palettes, SEO meta tags, and JSON-LD schema markup, and searches the Brandize design guides. The free tools are anonymous; logo purchases go through a Stripe checkout link the user opens themselves.
defaultPrompt: Use Brandize to generate a logo for my business.
Use Brandize to build a five-color brand palette from #2563EB.
Use Brandize to write the meta tags and JSON-LD for my landing page.
